verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch is a data platform/search engine, not an AI agent or orchestrator that consumes external tools via MCP; the evidence shows Elasticsearch ships an official MCP *server* (elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch) so agents can call Elasticsearch, which is the opposite role from what this story asks. Plugging external MCP servers into Elasticsearch so it can 'use their tools' is a category error for this product type.
